title: Alexander the Great
summary: Macedonian king whose empire was divided after his death.
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Taking Europe for Jesus). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: PROVISIONAL: no CFAH, Ussher–Jones or Ussher date exists, so the sort uses Generations (Taking Europe for Jesus, PDF p. 37): 356-323 BC. Pending owner decision (open question A8).
